requirement:
The Python repository you were given has a bug. Fix it in place so the behaviour described in SPEC holds. Keep every public function and its signature, keep the existing tests passing, and add a regression test that would have caught the bug.

SYMPTOM: `median([1, 2, 3, 4])` returns 3 instead of 2.5.

SPEC: Median of a non-empty list; for an even count it is the mean of the two middle values. Empty list raises ValueError.

The code is in `lib/stats.py`; read it from the repository (it is not repeated here).
